# Rabbit's Premier Property Care

> Owner-operated residential property care in Hampton Roads, Virginia (Portsmouth, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Virginia Beach, Suffolk), run by Billy C. Hernandez. Lawn care and yard cleanup, seasonal and decorative lighting installation, pressure washing, painting, drywall repair, and hardscaping by estimate. Every residential price is published with its units and minimums. Insured. Free estimates. Formerly Rabbit's Lawn & Garden Care.

- Phone (call or text): 948-900-7254
- Email: rabbits.premier@gmail.com
- Office: 900 Commonwealth Pl, Suite 200, Virginia Beach, VA 23464
- Hours: every day, 6 a.m. to 6 p.m.
- Commercial and property-management work: on-site assessment and custom quote

## Prices (residential, current as of November 2026)

- Routine lawn maintenance (mow, edge, trim): $75 per visit for most average properties; size-dependent
- Leaf cleanup: starting at $150 per visit
- Seasonal and decorative lighting installation: $2.83 per linear foot of first-story labor; +50% of base per additional story; lights and materials separate
- Concrete pressure washing (driveways, walkways, patios): $0.40 per sq. ft.; $200 minimum per standalone visit
- House exterior soft wash: one-story from $300, two-story from $450
- Interior painting (walls, ceilings): $2 per sq. ft. of surface, labor only; $350 minimum
- Drywall repair: $250 standalone minimum; new drywall $2.50 per sq. ft., $500 minimum
- Hardscaping (patios, walkways, retaining walls, fire pits): by on-site estimate only
